15.zh: 祭司示巴尼 、 约沙法 、 拿坦业 、 亚玛赛 、 撒迦利雅 、 比拿亚 、 以利以谢在神的约柜前吹号。俄别以东和耶希亚也是约柜前守门的。
15.en: Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah and Eliezer the priests were to blow trumpets before the ark of God. Obed-Edom and Jehiah were also to be doorkeepers for the ark.

15.zh: 于是，大卫和以色列的长老，并千夫长都去从俄别以东的家欢欢喜喜地将耶和华的约柜抬上来。
15.en: So David and the elders of Israel and the commanders of units of a thousand went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the Lord from the house of Obed-Edom, with rejoicing.

15.zh: 神赐恩与抬耶和华约柜的利未人，他们就献上七只公牛，七只公羊。
15.en: Because God had helped the Levites who were carrying the ark of the covenant of the Lord , seven bulls and seven rams were sacrificed.

15.zh: 大卫和抬约柜的利未人，并歌唱人的首领基拿尼雅，以及歌唱的人，都穿著细麻布的外袍；大卫另外穿著细麻布的以弗得。
15.en: Now David was clothed in a robe of fine linen, as were all the Levites who were carrying the ark, and as were the singers, and Kenaniah, who was in charge of the singing of the choirs. David also wore a linen ephod.

15.zh: 这样，以色列众人欢呼吹角 、 吹号 、 敲钹 、 鼓瑟 、 弹琴，大发响声，将耶和华的约柜抬上来。
15.en: So all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the Lord with shouts, with the sounding of rams' horns and trumpets, and of cymbals, and the playing of lyres and harps.

15.zh: 耶和华的约柜进了大卫城的时候，扫罗的女儿米甲从窗户里观看，见大卫王踊跃跳舞，心里就轻视他。
15.en: As the ark of the covenant of the Lord was entering the City of David, Michal daughter of Saul watched from a window. And when she saw King David dancing and celebrating, she despised him in her heart.

16.zh: 众人将神的约柜请进去，安放在大卫所搭的帐幕里，就在神面前献燔祭和平安祭。
16.en: They brought the ark of God and set it inside the tent that David had pitched for it, and they presented burnt offerings and fellowship offerings before God.

16.zh: 大卫献完了燔祭和平安祭，就奉耶和华的名给民祝福，
16.en: After David had finished sacrificing the burnt offerings and fellowship offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord .

16.zh: 并且分给以色列人，无论男女，每人一个饼，一块肉，一个葡萄饼。
16.en: Then he gave a loaf of bread, a cake of dates and a cake of raisins to each Israelite man and woman.

16.zh: 大卫派几个利未人在耶和华的约柜前事奉，颂扬，称谢，赞美耶和华 ─ 以色列的神：
16.en: He appointed some of the Levites to minister before the ark of the Lord , to make petition, to give thanks, and to praise the Lord , the God of Israel:

16.zh: 为首的是亚萨，其次是撒迦利雅 、 雅薛 、 示米拉末 、 耶歇 、 玛他提雅 、 以利押 、 比拿雅 、 俄别以东 、 耶利，鼓瑟弹琴；惟有亚萨敲钹，大发响声；
16.en: Asaph was the chief, Zechariah second, then Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-Edom and Jeiel. They were to play the lyres and harps, Asaph was to sound the cymbals,

16.zh: 祭司比拿雅和雅哈悉常在神的约柜前吹号。
16.en: and Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests were to blow the trumpets regularly before the ark of the covenant of God.

16.zh: 那日，大卫初次藉亚萨和他的弟兄以诗歌称颂耶和华，说：
16.en: That day David first committed to Asaph and his associates this psalm of thanks to the Lord :

16.zh: 你们要称谢耶和华，求告他的名，在万民中传扬他的作为！
16.en: Give thanks to the Lord , call on his name; make known among the nations what he has done.

16.zh: 要向他唱诗 、 歌颂，谈论他一切奇妙的作为。
16.en: Sing to him, sing praise to him; tell of all his wonderful acts.

16.zh: 要以他的圣名夸耀；寻求耶和华的人，心中应当欢喜。
16.en: Glory in his holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the Lord rejoice.

16.zh: 要寻求耶和华与他的能力，时常寻求他的面。
16.en: Look to the Lord and his strength; seek his face always.

16.zh: 他仆人以色列的后裔，他所拣选雅各的子孙哪，你们要记念他奇妙的作为和他的奇事，并他口中的判语。
16.en: Remember the wonders he has done, his miracles, and the judgments he pronounced,

16.zh: a
16.en: O descendants of Israel his servant, O sons of Jacob, his chosen ones.

16.zh: 他是耶和华 ─ 我们的神，全地都有他的判断。
16.en: He is the Lord our God; his judgments are in all the earth.

16.zh: 你们要记念他的约，直到永远；他所吩咐的话，直到千代，
16.en: He remembers his covenant forever, the word he commanded, for a thousand generations,

16.zh: 就是与亚伯拉罕所立的约，向以撒所起的誓。
16.en: the covenant he made with Abraham, the oath he swore to Isaac.

16.zh: 他又将这约向雅各定为律例，向以色列定为永远的约，
16.en: He confirmed it to Jacob as a decree, to Israel as an everlasting covenant:

16.zh: 说：我必将迦南地赐给你，作你产业的分。
16.en: "To you I will give the land of Canaan as the portion you will inherit."

16.zh: 当时你们人丁有限，数目稀少，并且在那地为寄居的；
16.en: When they were but few in number, few indeed, and strangers in it,

16.zh: 他们从这邦游到那邦，从这国行到那国。
16.en: they wandered from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another.

16.zh: 耶和华不容甚么人欺负他们，为他们的缘故责备君王，
16.en: He allowed no man to oppress them; for their sake he rebuked kings:

16.zh: 说：不可难为我受膏的人，也不可恶待我的先知！
16.en: "Do not touch my anointed ones; do my prophets no harm."

16.zh: 全地都要向耶和华歌唱！天天传扬他的救恩，
16.en: Sing to the Lord , all the earth; proclaim his salvation day after day.

16.zh: 在列邦中述说他的荣耀，在万民中述说他的奇事。
16.en: Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous deeds among all peoples.

16.zh: 因耶和华为大，当受极大的赞美；他在万神之上，当受敬畏。
16.en: For great is the Lord and most worthy of praise; he is to be feared above all gods.

16.zh: 外邦的神都属虚无，惟独耶和华创造诸天。
16.en: For all the gods of the nations are idols, but the Lord made the heavens.

16.zh: 有尊荣和威严在他面前，有能力和喜乐在他圣所。
16.en: Splendor and majesty are before him; strength and joy in his dwelling place.

16.zh: 民中的万族啊，你们要将荣耀能力归给耶和华，都归给耶和华！
16.en: Ascribe to the Lord , O families of nations, ascribe to the Lord glory and strength,

16.zh: 要将耶和华的名所当得的荣耀归给他，拿供物来奉到他面前；当以圣洁的 ( 的或作为 ) 妆饰敬拜耶和华。
16.en: ascribe to the Lord the glory due his name. Bring an offering and come before him; worship the Lord in the splendor of his holiness.

16.zh: 全地要在他面前战抖，世界也坚定不得动摇。
16.en: Tremble before him, all the earth! The world is firmly established; it cannot be moved.

16.zh: 愿天欢喜，愿地快乐；愿人在列邦中说：耶和华作王了
16.en: Let the heavens rejoice, let the earth be glad; let them say among the nations, "The Lord reigns!"

16.zh: 愿海和其中所充满的澎湃；愿田和其中所有的都欢乐。
16.en: Let the sea resound, and all that is in it; let the fields be jubilant, and everything in them!

16.zh: 那时，林中的树木都要在耶和华面前欢呼，因为他来要审判全地。
16.en: Then the trees of the forest will sing, they will sing for joy before the Lord , for he comes to judge the earth.

16.zh: 应当称谢耶和华；因他本为善，他的慈爱永远长存！
16.en: Give thanks to the Lord , for he is good; his love endures forever.

16.zh: 要说：拯救我们的神啊，求你救我们，聚集我们，使我们脱离外邦，我们好称赞你的圣名，以赞美你为夸胜。
16.en: Cry out, "Save us, O God our Savior; gather us and deliver us from the nations, that we may give thanks to your holy name, that we may glory in your praise."

16.zh: 耶和华 ─ 以色列的神，从亘古直到永远，是应当称颂的！众民都说：阿们！并且赞美耶和华。
16.en: Praise be to the Lord , the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Then all the people said "Amen" and "Praise the Lord ."

16.zh: 大卫派亚萨和他的弟兄在约柜前常常事奉耶和华，一日尽一日的职分；
16.en: David left Asaph and his associates before the ark of the covenant of the Lord to minister there regularly, according to each day's requirements.

16.zh: 又派俄别以东和他的弟兄六十八人，与耶杜顿的儿子俄别以东，并何萨作守门的；
16.en: He also left Obed-Edom and his sixty-eight associates to minister with them. Obed-Edom son of Jeduthun, and also Hosah, were gatekeepers.

16.zh: 且派祭司撒督和他弟兄众祭司在基遍的邱坛 、 耶和华的帐幕前燔祭坛上，每日早晚，照著耶和华律法书上所吩咐以色列人的，常给耶和华献燔祭。
16.en: David left Zadok the priest and his fellow priests before the tabernacle of the Lord at the high place in Gibeon

16.zh: a
16.en: to present burnt offerings to the Lord on the altar of burnt offering regularly, morning and evening, in accordance with everything written in the Law of the Lord , which he had given Israel.

16.zh: 与他们一同被派的有希幔 、 耶杜顿，和其余被选名字录在册上的，称谢耶和华，因他的慈爱永远长存。
16.en: With them were Heman and Jeduthun and the rest of those chosen and designated by name to give thanks to the Lord , "for his love endures forever."

16.zh: 希幔 、 耶杜顿同著他们吹号 、 敲钹，大发响声，并用别的乐器随著歌颂神。耶杜顿的子孙作守门的。
16.en: Heman and Jeduthun were responsible for the sounding of the trumpets and cymbals and for the playing of the other instruments for sacred song. The sons of Jeduthun were stationed at the gate.

16.zh: 于是众民各归各家；大卫也回去为家眷祝福。
16.en: Then all the people left, each for his own home, and David returned home to bless his family.

17.zh: 大卫住在自己宫中，对先知拿单说：看哪，我住在香柏木的宫中，耶和华的约柜反在幔子里。
17.en: After David was settled in his palace, he said to Nathan the prophet, "Here I am, living in a palace of cedar, while the ark of the covenant of the Lord is under a tent."

17.zh: 拿单对大卫说：你可以照你的心意而行，因为神与你同在。
17.en: Nathan replied to David, "Whatever you have in mind, do it, for God is with you."

17.zh: 当夜，神的话临到拿单，说：
17.en: That night the word of God came to Nathan, saying:

17.zh: 你去告诉我仆人大卫，说耶和华如此说：你不可建造殿宇给我居住。
17.en: "Go and tell my servant David, 'This is what the Lord says: You are not the one to build me a house to dwell in.

17.zh: 自从我领以色列人出埃及，直到今日，我未曾住过殿宇，乃从这会幕到那会幕，从这帐幕到那帐幕。
17.en: I have not dwelt in a house from the day I brought Israel up out of Egypt to this day. I have moved from one tent site to another, from one dwelling place to another.

17.zh: 凡我同以色列人所走的地方，我何曾向以色列的一个士师，就是我吩咐牧养我民的说：你为何不给我建造香柏木的殿宇呢？
17.en: Wherever I have moved with all the Israelites, did I ever say to any of their leaders whom I commanded to shepherd my people, "Why have you not built me a house of cedar?" '

17.zh: 现在你要告诉我仆人大卫，说万军之耶和华如此说：我从羊圈中将你召来，叫你不再跟从羊群，立你作我民以色列的君。
17.en: "Now then, tell my servant David, 'This is what the Lord Almighty says: I took you from the pasture and from following the flock, to be ruler over my people Israel.

17.zh: 你无论往哪里去，我常与你同在，剪除你的一切仇敌；我必使你得大名，好像世上大大有名的人一样。
17.en: I have been with you wherever you have gone, and I have cut off all your enemies from before you. Now I will make your name like the names of the greatest men of the earth.

17.zh: 我必为我民以色列选定一个地方，栽培他们，使他们住自己的地方，不再迁移；凶恶之子也不像从前扰害他们，
17.en: And I will provide a place for my people Israel and will plant them so that they can have a home of their own and no longer be disturbed. Wicked people will not oppress them anymore, as they did at the beginning

17.zh: 并不像我命士师治理我民以色列的时候一样。我必治服你的一切仇敌，并且我 ─ 耶和华应许你，必为你建立家室。
17.en: and have done ever since the time I appointed leaders over my people Israel. I will also subdue all your enemies. " 'I declare to you that the Lord will build a house for you:

17.zh: 你寿数满足归你列祖的时候，我必使你的后裔接续你的位，我也必坚定他的国。
17.en: When your days are over and you go to be with your fathers, I will raise up your offspring to succeed you, one of your own sons, and I will establish his kingdom.

17.zh: 他必为我建造殿宇；我必坚定他的国位直到永远。
17.en: He is the one who will build a house for me, and I will establish his throne forever.

17.zh: 我要作他的父，他要作我的子；并不使我的慈爱离开他，像离开在你以前的扫罗一样。
17.en: I will be his father, and he will be my son. I will never take my love away from him, as I took it away from your predecessor.

17.zh: 我却要将他永远坚立在我家里和我国里；他的国位也必坚定，直到永远。
17.en: I will set him over my house and my kingdom forever; his throne will be established forever.' "

17.zh: 拿单就按这一切话，照这默示告诉大卫。
17.en: Nathan reported to David all the words of this entire revelation.

17.zh: 于是大卫王进去，坐在耶和华面前，说：耶和华神啊，我是谁，我的家算甚么，你竟使我到这地步呢？
17.en: Then King David went in and sat before the Lord , and he said: "Who am I, O Lord God, and what is my family, that you have brought me this far?

17.zh: 神啊，这在你眼中还看为小，又应许你仆人的家至于久远。耶和华神啊，你看顾我好像看顾高贵的人。
17.en: And as if this were not enough in your sight, O God, you have spoken about the future of the house of your servant. You have looked on me as though I were the most exalted of men, O Lord God.

17.zh: 你加于仆人的尊荣，我还有何言可说呢？因为你知道你的仆人。
17.en: "What more can David say to you for honoring your servant? For you know your servant,

17.zh: 耶和华啊，你行了这大事，并且显明出来，是因你仆人的缘故，也是照你的心意。
17.en: O Lord . For the sake of your servant and according to your will, you have done this great thing and made known all these great promises.

17.zh: 耶和华啊，照我们耳中听见，没有可比你的，除你以外再无神。
17.en: "There is no one like you, O Lord , and there is no God but you, as we have heard with our own ears.

17.zh: 世上有何民能比你的民以色列呢？你神从埃及救赎他们作自己的子民，又在你赎出来的民面前行大而可畏的事，驱逐列邦人，显出你的大名。
17.en: And who is like your people Israel-the one nation on earth whose God went out to redeem a people for himself, and to make a name for yourself, and to perform great and awesome wonders by driving out nations from before your people, whom you redeemed from Egypt?

17.zh: 你使以色列人作你的子民，直到永远；你 ─ 耶和华也作他们的神。
17.en: You made your people Israel your very own forever, and you, O Lord , have become their God.

17.zh: 耶和华啊，你所应许仆人和仆人家的话，求你坚定，直到永远，照你所说的而行。
17.en: "And now, Lord , let the promise you have made concerning your servant and his house be established forever. Do as you promised,

17.zh: 愿你的名永远坚立，被尊为大，说：万军之耶和华是以色列的神，是治理以色列的神。这样，你仆人大卫的家必在你面前坚立。
17.en: so that it will be established and that your name will be great forever. Then men will say, 'The Lord Almighty, the God over Israel, is Israel's God!' And the house of your servant David will be established before you.

17.zh: 我的神啊，因你启示仆人说，我必为你建立家室，所以仆人大胆在你面前祈祷。
17.en: "You, my God, have revealed to your servant that you will build a house for him. So your servant has found courage to pray to you.

17.zh: 耶和华啊，惟有你是神，你也应许将这福气赐给仆人。
17.en: O Lord , you are God! You have promised these good things to your servant.

17.zh: 现在你喜悦赐福与仆人的家，可以永存在你面前。耶和华啊，你已经赐福，还要赐福到永远。
17.en: Now you have been pleased to bless the house of your servant, that it may continue forever in your sight; for you, O Lord , have blessed it, and it will be blessed forever."

18.zh: 此后，大卫攻打非利士人，把他们治服，从他们手下夺取了迦特和属迦特的村庄；
18.en: In the course of time, David defeated the Philistines and subdued them, and he took Gath and its surrounding villages from the control of the Philistines.

18.zh: 又攻打摩押，摩押人就归服大卫，给他进贡。
18.en: David also defeated the Moabites, and they became subject to him and brought tribute.

18.zh: 琐巴王哈大利谢 ( 撒下八章三节作哈大底谢 ) 往伯拉河去，要坚定自己的国权，大卫就攻打他，直到哈马，
18.en: Moreover, David fought Hadadezer king of Zobah, as far as Hamath, when he went to establish his control along the Euphrates River.

18.zh: 夺了他的战车一千，马兵七千，步兵二万，将拉战车的马砍断蹄筋，但留下一百辆车的马。
18.en: David captured a thousand of his chariots, seven thousand charioteers and twenty thousand foot soldiers. He hamstrung all but a hundred of the chariot horses.

18.zh: 大马色的亚兰人来帮助琐巴王哈大利谢，大卫就杀了亚兰人二万二千。
18.en: When the Arameans of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck down twenty-two thousand of them.

18.zh: 于是大卫在大马色的亚兰地设立防营，亚兰人就归服他，给他进贡。大卫无论往哪里去，耶和华都使他得胜。
18.en: He put garrisons in the Aramean kingdom of Damascus, and the Arameans became subject to him and brought tribute. The Lord gave David victory everywhere he went.

18.zh: 他夺了哈大利谢臣仆所拿的金盾牌带到耶路撒冷。
18.en: David took the gold shields carried by the officers of Hadadezer and brought them to Jerusalem.

18.zh: 大卫又从属哈大利谢的提巴 ( 或作比他 ) 和均二城中夺取了许多的铜。后来所罗门用此制造铜海 、 铜柱，和一切的铜器。
18.en: From Tebah and Cun, towns that belonged to Hadadezer, David took a great quantity of bronze, which Solomon used to make the bronze Sea, the pillars and various bronze articles.

18.zh: 哈马王陀乌听见大卫杀败琐巴王哈大利谢的全军，
18.en: When Tou king of Hamath heard that David had defeated the entire army of Hadadezer king of Zobah,

18.zh: 就打发他儿子哈多兰去见大卫王，问他的安，为他祝福，因为他杀败了哈大利谢 〈 原来陀乌与哈大利谢常常争战 〉 。哈多兰带了金银铜的各样器皿来。
18.en: he sent his son Hadoram to King David to greet him and congratulate him on his victory in battle over Hadadezer, who had been at war with Tou. Hadoram brought all kinds of articles of gold and silver and bronze.

18.zh: 大卫王将这些器皿，并从各国夺来的金银，就是从以东 、 摩押 、 亚扪 、 非利士 、 亚玛力人所夺来的，都分别为圣献给耶和华。
18.en: King David dedicated these articles to the Lord , as he had done with the silver and gold he had taken from all these nations: Edom and Moab, the Ammonites and the Philistines, and Amalek.

18.zh: 洗鲁雅的儿子亚比筛在盐谷击杀了以东一万八千人。
18.en: Abishai son of Zeruiah struck down eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt.

18.zh: 大卫在以东地设立防营，以东人就都归服他。大卫无论往哪里去，耶和华都使他得胜。
18.en: He put garrisons in Edom, and all the Edomites became subject to David. The Lord gave David victory everywhere he went.

18.zh: 大卫作以色列众人的王，又向众民秉公行义。
18.en: David reigned over all Israel, doing what was just and right for all his people.

18.zh: 洗鲁雅的儿子约押作元帅；亚希律的儿子约沙法作史官；
18.en: Joab son of Zeruiah was over the army; Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was recorder;

18.zh: 亚希突的儿子撒督和亚比亚他的儿子亚希米勒作祭司长；沙威沙作书记；
18.en: Zadok son of Ahitub and Ahimelech son of Abiathar were priests; Shavsha was secretary;

18.zh: 耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅统辖基利提人和比利提人。大卫的众子都在王的左右作领袖。
18.en: Benaiah son of Jehoiada was over the Kerethites and Pelethites; and David's sons were chief officials at the king's side.

19.zh: 此后，亚扪人的王拿辖死了，他儿子接续他作王。
19.en: In the course of time, Nahash king of the Ammonites died, and his son succeeded him as king.

19.zh: 大卫说：我要照哈嫩的父亲拿辖厚待我的恩典厚待哈嫩。于是大卫差遣使者为他丧父安慰他。大卫的臣仆到了亚扪人的境内见哈嫩，要安慰他，
19.en: David thought, "I will show kindness to Hanun son of Nahash, because his father showed kindness to me." So David sent a delegation to express his sympathy to Hanun concerning his father. When David's men came to Hanun in the land of the Ammonites to express sympathy to him,

19.zh: 但亚扪人的首领对哈嫩说：大卫差人来安慰你，你想他是尊敬你父亲么？他的臣仆来见你不是为详察窥探 、 倾覆这地么？
19.en: the Ammonite nobles said to Hanun, "Do you think David is honoring your father by sending men to you to express sympathy? Haven't his men come to you to explore and spy out the country and overthrow it?"

19.zh: 哈嫩便将大卫臣仆的胡须剃去一半，又割断他们下半截的衣服，使他们露出下体，打发他们回去。
19.en: So Hanun seized David's men, shaved them, cut off their garments in the middle at the buttocks, and sent them away.

19.zh: 有人将臣仆所遇的事告诉大卫，他就差人去迎接他们，因为他们甚觉羞耻；告诉他们说：可以住在耶利哥，等到胡须长起再回来。
19.en: When someone came and told David about the men, he sent messengers to meet them, for they were greatly humiliated. The king said, "Stay at Jericho till your beards have grown, and then come back."

19.zh: 亚扪人知道大卫憎恶他们，哈嫩和亚扪人就打发人拿一千他连得银子，从米所波大米 、 亚兰 、 玛迦 、 琐巴雇战车和马兵，
19.en: When the Ammonites realized that they had become a stench in David's nostrils, Hanun and the Ammonites sent a thousand talents of silver to hire chariots and charioteers from Aram Naharaim, Aram Maacah and Zobah.

19.zh: 于是雇了三万二千辆战车和玛迦王并他的军兵；他们来安营在米底巴前。亚扪人也从他们的城里出来，聚集交战。
19.en: They hired thirty-two thousand chariots and charioteers, as well as the king of Maacah with his troops, who came and camped near Medeba, while the Ammonites were mustered from their towns and moved out for battle.

19.zh: 大卫听见了，就差派约押统带勇猛的全军出去。
19.en: On hearing this, David sent Joab out with the entire army of fighting men.

19.zh: 亚扪人出来在城门前摆阵，所来的诸王另在郊野摆阵。
19.en: The Ammonites came out and drew up in battle formation at the entrance to their city, while the kings who had come were by themselves in the open country.

19.zh: 约押看见敌人在他前后摆阵，就从以色列军中挑选精兵，使他们对著亚兰人摆阵；
19.en: Joab saw that there were battle lines in front of him and behind him; so he selected some of the best troops in Israel and deployed them against the Arameans.

19.zh: 其余的兵交与他兄弟亚比筛，对著亚扪人摆阵。
19.en: He put the rest of the men under the command of Abishai his brother, and they were deployed against the Ammonites.

19.zh: 约押对亚比筛说：亚兰人若强过我，你就来帮助我；亚扪人若强过你，我就去帮助你。
19.en: Joab said, "If the Arameans are too strong for me, then you are to rescue me; but if the Ammonites are too strong for you, then I will rescue you.

19.zh: 我们都当刚强，为本国的民和神的城邑作大丈夫，愿耶和华凭他的意旨而行。
19.en: Be strong and let us fight bravely for our people and the cities of our God. The Lord will do what is good in his sight."

19.zh: 于是约押和跟随他的人前进攻打亚兰人；亚兰人在约押面前逃跑。
19.en: Then Joab and the troops with him advanced to fight the Arameans, and they fled before him.

19.zh: 亚扪人见亚兰人逃跑，他们也在约押的兄弟亚比筛面前逃跑进城。约押就回耶路撒冷去了。
19.en: When the Ammonites saw that the Arameans were fleeing, they too fled before his brother Abishai and went inside the city. So Joab went back to Jerusalem.

19.zh: 亚兰人见自己被以色列人打败，就打发使者将大河那边的亚兰人调来，哈大利谢的将军朔法率领他们。
19.en: After the Arameans saw that they had been routed by Israel, they sent messengers and had Arameans brought from beyond the River, with Shophach the commander of Hadadezer's army leading them.

19.zh: 有人告诉大卫，他就聚集以色列众人过约但河，来到亚兰人那里，迎著他们摆阵。大卫既摆阵攻击亚兰人，亚兰人就与他打仗。
19.en: When David was told of this, he gathered all Israel and crossed the Jordan; he advanced against them and formed his battle lines opposite them. David formed his lines to meet the Arameans in battle, and they fought against him.

19.zh: 亚兰人在以色列人面前逃跑。大卫杀了亚兰七千辆战车的人，四万步兵，又杀了亚兰的将军朔法。
19.en: But they fled before Israel, and David killed seven thousand of their charioteers and forty thousand of their foot soldiers. He also killed Shophach the commander of their army.

19.zh: 属哈大利谢的诸王见自己被以色列人打败，就与大卫和好，归服他。于是亚兰人不敢再帮助亚扪人了。
19.en: When the vassals of Hadadezer saw that they had been defeated by Israel, they made peace with David and became subject to him. So the Arameans were not willing to help the Ammonites anymore.

20.zh: 过了一年，到列王出战的时候，约押率领军兵毁坏亚扪人的地，围攻拉巴；大卫仍住在耶路撒冷。约押攻打拉巴，将城倾覆。
20.en: In the spring, at the time when kings go off to war, Joab led out the armed forces. He laid waste the land of the Ammonites and went to Rabbah and besieged it, but David remained in Jerusalem. Joab attacked Rabbah and left it in ruins.

20.zh: 大卫夺了亚扪人之王 ( 王或作玛勒堪。玛勒堪即米勒公，是亚扪族之神名 ) 所戴的金冠冕，其上的金子重一他连得，又嵌著宝石；人将这冠冕戴在大卫头上。大卫从城里夺了许多财物，
20.en: David took the crown from the head of their king -its weight was found to be a talent of gold, and it was set with precious stones-and it was placed on David's head. He took a great quantity of plunder from the city

20.zh: 将城里的人拉出来，放在锯下，或铁耙下，或铁斧下 ( 或作强他们用锯，或用打粮食的铁器，或用铁斧作工 ) ，大卫待亚扪各城的居民都是如此。其后大卫和众军都回耶路撒冷去了。
20.en: and brought out the people who were there, consigning them to labor with saws and with iron picks and axes. David did this to all the Ammonite towns. Then David and his entire army returned to Jerusalem.

20.zh: 后来，以色列人在基色与非利士人打仗。户沙人西比该杀了伟人的一个儿子细派，非利士人就被制伏了。
20.en: In the course of time, war broke out with the Philistines, at Gezer. At that time Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Sippai, one of the descendants of the Rephaites, and the Philistines were subjugated.

20.zh: 又与非利士人打仗。睚珥的儿子伊勒哈难杀了迦特人歌利亚的兄弟拉哈米；这人的枪杆粗如织布的机轴。
20.en: In another battle with the Philistines, Elhanan son of Jair killed Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, who had a spear with a shaft like a weaver's rod.

20.zh: 又在迦特打仗。那里有一个身量高大的人，手脚都是六指，共有二十四个指头，他也是伟人的儿子。
20.en: In still another battle, which took place at Gath, there was a huge man with six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot-twenty-four in all. He also was descended from Rapha.

20.zh: 这人向以色列人骂阵，大卫的哥哥示米亚的儿子约拿单就杀了他。
20.en: When he taunted Israel, Jonathan son of Shimea, David's brother, killed him.

20.zh: 这三个人是迦特伟人的儿子，都死在大卫和他仆人的手下。
20.en: These were descendants of Rapha in Gath, and they fell at the hands of David and his men.

21.zh: 撒但起来攻击以色列人，激动大卫数点他们。
21.en: Satan rose up against Israel andincited David to take a census of Israel.

21.zh: 大卫就吩咐约押和民中的首领说：你们去数点以色列人，从别是巴直到但，回来告诉我，我好知道他们的数目。
21.en: So David said to Joab and the commanders of the troops, "Go and count the Israelites from Beersheba to Dan. Then report back to me so that I may know how many there are."

21.zh: 约押说：愿耶和华使他的百姓比现在加增百倍。我主我王啊，他们不都是你的仆人么？我主为何吩咐行这事，为何使以色列人陷在罪里呢？
21.en: But Joab replied, "May the Lord multiply his troops a hundred times over. My lord the king, are they not all my lord's subjects? Why does my lord want to do this? Why should he bring guilt on Israel?"

21.zh: 但王的命令胜过约押。约押就出去，走遍以色列地，回到耶路撒冷，
21.en: The king's word, however, overruled Joab; so Joab left and went throughout Israel and then came back to Jerusalem.

21.zh: 将百姓的总数奏告大卫：以色列人拿刀的有一百一十万；犹大人拿刀的有四十七万。
21.en: Joab reported the number of the fighting men to David: In all Israel there were one million one hundred thousand men who could handle a sword, including four hundred and seventy thousand in Judah.

21.zh: 惟有利未人和便雅悯人没有数在其中，因为约押厌恶王的这命令。
21.en: But Joab did not include Levi and Benjamin in the numbering, because the king's command was repulsive to him.

21.zh: 神不喜悦这数点百姓的事，便降灾给以色列人。
21.en: This command was also evil in the sight of God; so he punished Israel.

21.zh: 大卫祷告神说：我行这事大有罪了！现在求你除掉仆人的罪孽，因我所行的甚是愚昧。
21.en: Then David said to God, "I have sinned greatly by doing this. Now, I beg you, take away the guilt of your servant. I have done a very foolish thing."

21.zh: 耶和华吩咐大卫的先见迦得说：
21.en: The Lord said to Gad, David's seer,

21.zh: 你去告诉大卫说，耶和华如此说：我有三样灾，随你选择一样，我好降与你。
21.en: "Go and tell David, 'This is what the Lord says: I am giving you three options. Choose one of them for me to carry out against you.' "

21.zh: 于是，迦得来见大卫，对他说：耶和华如此说：你可以随意选择：
21.en: So Gad went to David and said to him, "This is what the Lord says: 'Take your choice:

21.zh: 或三年的饥荒；或败在你敌人面前，被敌人的刀追杀三个月；或在你国中有耶和华的刀，就是三日的瘟疫，耶和华的使者在以色列的四境施行毁灭。现在你要想一想，我好回覆那差我来的。
21.en: three years of famine, three months of being swept away before your enemies, with their swords overtaking you, or three days of the sword of the Lord - days of plague in the land, with the angel of the Lord ravaging every part of Israel.' Now then, decide how I should answer the one who sent me."

21.zh: 大卫对迦得说：我甚为难。我愿落在耶和华的手里，因为他有丰盛的怜悯；我不愿落在人的手里。
21.en: David said to Gad, "I am in deep distress. Let me fall into the hands of the Lord , for his mercy is very great; but do not let me fall into the hands of men."

21.zh: 于是，耶和华降瘟疫与以色列人，以色列人就死了七万。
21.en: So the Lord sent a plague on Israel, and seventy thousand men of Israel fell dead.

21.zh: 神差遣使者去灭耶路撒冷，刚要灭的时候，耶和华看见后悔，就不降这灾了，吩咐灭城的天使说：够了，住手罢！那时，耶和华的使者站在耶布斯人阿珥楠的禾场那里。
21.en: And God sent an angel to destroy Jerusalem. But as the angel was doing so, the Lord saw it and was grieved because of the calamity and said to the angel who was destroying the people, "Enough! Withdraw your hand." The angel of the Lord was then standing at the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.

21.zh: 大卫举目，看见耶和华的使者站在天地间，手里有拔出来的刀，伸在耶路撒冷以上。大卫和长老都身穿麻衣，面伏于地。
21.en: David looked up and saw the angel of the Lord standing between heaven and earth, with a drawn sword in his hand extended over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell facedown.

21.zh: 大卫祷告神说：吩咐数点百姓的不是我么？我犯了罪，行了恶，但这群羊做了甚么呢？愿耶和华 ─ 我神的手攻击我和我的父家，不要攻击你的民，降瘟疫与他们。
21.en: David said to God, "Was it not I who ordered the fighting men to be counted? I am the one who has sinned and done wrong. These are but sheep. What have they done? O Lord my God, let your hand fall upon me and my family, but do not let this plague remain on your people."

21.zh: 耶和华的使者吩咐迦得去告诉大卫，叫他上去，在耶布斯人阿珥楠的禾场上为耶和华筑一座坛；
21.en: Then the angel of the Lord ordered Gad to tell David to go up and build an altar to the Lord on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.

21.zh: 大卫就照著迦得奉耶和华名所说的话上去了。
21.en: So David went up in obedience to the word that Gad had spoken in the name of the Lord .

21.zh: 那时阿珥楠正打麦子，回头看见天使，就和他四个儿子都藏起来了。
21.en: While Araunah was threshing wheat, he turned and saw the angel; his four sons who were with him hid themselves.

21.zh: 大卫到了阿珥楠那里，阿珥楠看见大卫，就从禾场上出去，脸伏于地，向他下拜。
21.en: Then David approached, and when Araunah looked and saw him, he left the threshing floor and bowed down before David with his face to the ground.

21.zh: 大卫对阿珥楠说：你将这禾场与相连之地卖给我，我必给你足价，我好在其上为耶和华筑一座坛，使民间的瘟疫止住。
21.en: David said to him, "Let me have the site of your threshing floor so I can build an altar to the Lord , that the plague on the people may be stopped. Sell it to me at the full price."

21.zh: 阿珥楠对大卫说：你可以用这禾场，愿我主我王照你所喜悦的去行。我也将牛给你作燔祭，把打粮的器具当柴烧，拿麦子作素祭。这些我都送给你。
21.en: Araunah said to David, "Take it! Let my lord the king do whatever pleases him. Look, I will give the oxen for the burnt offerings, the threshing sledges for the wood, and the wheat for the grain offering. I will give all this."

21.zh: 大卫王对阿珥楠说：不然！我必要用足价向你买。我不用你的物献给耶和华，也不用白得之物献为燔祭。
21.en: But King David replied to Araunah, "No, I insist on paying the full price. I will not take for the Lord what is yours, or sacrifice a burnt offering that costs me nothing."

21.zh: 于是大卫为那块地平了六百舍客勒金子给阿珥楠。
21.en: So David paid Araunah six hundred shekels of gold for the site.

21.zh: 大卫在那里为耶和华筑了一座坛，献燔祭和平安祭，求告耶和华。耶和华就应允他，使火从天降在燔祭坛上。
21.en: David built an altar to the Lord there and sacrificed burnt offerings and fellowship offerings. He called on the Lord , and the Lord answered him with fire from heaven on the altar of burnt offering.

21.zh: 耶和华吩咐使者，他就收刀入鞘。
21.en: Then the Lord spoke to the angel, and he put his sword back into its sheath.

21.zh: 那时，大卫见耶和华在耶布斯人阿珥楠的禾场上应允了他，就在那里献祭。
21.en: At that time, when David saw that the Lord had answered him on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite, he offered sacrifices there.

21.zh: 摩西在旷野所造之耶和华的帐幕和燔祭坛都在基遍的高处；
21.en: The tabernacle of the Lord , which Moses had made in the desert, and the altar of burnt offering were at that time on the high place at Gibeon.

21.zh: 只是大卫不敢前去求问神，因为惧怕耶和华使者的刀。
21.en: But David could not go before it to inquire of God, because he was afraid of the sword of the angel of the Lord .

22.zh: 大卫说：这就是耶和华神的殿，为以色列人献燔祭的坛。
22.en: Then David said, "The house of the Lord God is to be here, and also the altar of burnt offering for Israel."

22.zh: 大卫吩咐聚集住以色列地的外邦人，从其中派石匠凿石头，要建造神的殿。
22.en: So David gave orders to assemble the aliens living in Israel, and from among them he appointed stonecutters to prepare dressed stone for building the house of God.

22.zh: 大卫预备许多铁做门上的钉子和钩子，又预备许多铜，多得无法可称；
22.en: He provided a large amount of iron to make nails for the doors of the gateways and for the fittings, and more bronze than could be weighed.

22.zh: 又预备无数的香柏木，因为西顿人和推罗人给大卫运了许多香柏木来。
22.en: He also provided more cedar logs than could be counted, for the Sidonians and Tyrians had brought large numbers of them to David.

22.zh: 大卫说：我儿子所罗门还年幼娇嫩，要为耶和华建造的殿宇必须高大辉煌，使名誉荣耀传遍万国；所以我要为殿预备材料。于是，大卫在未死之先预备的材料甚多。
22.en: David said, "My son Solomon is young and inexperienced, and the house to be built for the Lord should be of great magnificence and fame and splendor in the sight of all the nations. Therefore I will make preparations for it." So David made extensive preparations before his death.

22.zh: 大卫召了他儿子所罗门来，嘱咐他给耶和华 ─ 以色列的神建造殿宇，
22.en: Then he called for his son Solomon and charged him to build a house for the Lord , the God of Israel.

22.zh: 对所罗门说：我儿啊，我心里本想为耶和华 ─ 我神的名建造殿宇，
22.en: David said to Solomon: "My son, I had it in my heart to build a house for the Name of the Lord my God.

22.zh: 只是耶和华的话临到我说：你流了多人的血，打了多次大仗，你不可为我的名建造殿宇，因为你在我眼前使多人的血流在地上。
22.en: But this word of the Lord came to me: 'You have shed much blood and have fought many wars. You are not to build a house for my Name, because you have shed much blood on the earth in my sight.

22.zh: 你要生一个儿子，他必作太平的人；我必使他安静，不被四围的仇敌扰乱。他的名要叫所罗门 ( 即太平之意 ) 。他在位的日子，我必使以色列人平安康泰。
22.en: But you will have a son who will be a man of peace and rest, and I will give him rest from all his enemies on every side. His name will be Solomon, and I will grant Israel peace and quiet during his reign.

22.zh: 他必为我的名建造殿宇。他要作我的子；我要作他的父。他作以色列王；我必坚定他的国位，直到永远。
22.en: He is the one who will build a house for my Name. He will be my son, and I will be his father. And I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel forever.'

22.zh: 我儿啊，现今愿耶和华与你同在，使你亨通，照他指著你说的话，建造耶和华 ─ 你神的殿。
22.en: "Now, my son, the Lord be with you, and may you have success and build the house of the Lord your God, as he said you would.

22.zh: 但愿耶和华赐你聪明智慧，好治理以色列国，遵行耶和华 ─ 你神的律法。
22.en: May the Lord give you discretion and understanding when he puts you in command over Israel, so that you may keep the law of the Lord your God.

22.zh: 你若谨守遵行耶和华藉摩西吩咐以色列的律例典章，就得亨通。你当刚强壮胆，不要惧怕，也不要惊惶。
22.en: Then you will have success if you are careful to observe the decrees and laws that the Lord gave Moses for Israel. Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid or discouraged.

22.zh: 我在困难之中为耶和华的殿预备了金子十万他连得，银子一百万他连得，铜和铁多得无法可称；我也预备了木头 、 石头，你还可以增添。
22.en: "I have taken great pains to provide for the temple of the Lord a hundred thousand talents of gold, a million talents of silver, quantities of bronze and iron too great to be weighed, and wood and stone. And you may add to them.

22.zh: 你有许多匠人，就是石匠 、 木匠，和一切能做各样工的巧匠，
22.en: You have many workmen: stonecutters, masons and carpenters, as well as men skilled in every kind of work

22.zh: 并有无数的金银铜铁。你当起来办事，愿耶和华与你同在。
22.en: in gold and silver, bronze and iron-craftsmen beyond number. Now begin the work, and the Lord be with you."

22.zh: 大卫又吩咐以色列的众首领帮助他儿子所罗门，说：
22.en: Then David ordered all the leaders of Israel to help his son Solomon.

22.zh: 耶和华 ─ 你们的神不是与你们同在么？不是叫你们四围都平安么？因他已将这地的居民交在我手中，这地就在耶和华与他百姓面前制伏了。
22.en: He said to them, "Is not the Lord your God with you? And has he not granted you rest on every side? For he has handed the inhabitants of the land over to me, and the land is subject to the Lord and to his people.

22.zh: 现在你们应当立定心意，寻求耶和华 ─ 你们的神；也当起来建造耶和华神的圣所，好将耶和华的约柜和供奉神的圣器皿都搬进为耶和华名建造的殿里。
22.en: Now devote your heart and soul to seeking the Lord your God. Begin to build the sanctuary of the Lord God, so that you may bring the ark of the covenant of the Lord and the sacred articles belonging to God into the temple that will be built for the Name of the Lord ."

23.zh: 大卫年纪老迈，日子满足，就立他儿子所罗门作以色列的王。
23.en: When David was old and full of years, he made his son Solomon king over Israel.

23.zh: 大卫招聚以色列的众首领和祭司利未人。
23.en: He also gathered together all the leaders of Israel, as well as the priests and Levites.

23.zh: 利未人从三十岁以外的都被数点，他们男丁的数目共有三万八千；
23.en: The Levites thirty years old or more were counted, and the total number of men was thirty-eight thousand.

23.zh: 其中有二万四千人管理耶和华殿的事，有六千人作官长和士师，
23.en: David said, "Of these, twenty-four thousand are to supervise the work of the temple of the Lord and six thousand are to be officials and judges.

23.zh: 有四千人作守门的，又有四千人用大卫所做的乐器颂赞耶和华。
23.en: Four thousand are to be gatekeepers and four thousand are to praise the Lord with the musical instruments I have provided for that purpose."

23.zh: 大卫将利未人革顺 、 哥辖 、 米拉利的子孙分了班次。
23.en: David divided the Levites into groups corresponding to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath and Merari.

23.zh: 革顺的子孙有拉但和示每。
23.en: Belonging to the Gershonites: Ladan and Shimei.

23.zh: 拉但的长子是耶歇，还有细坦和约珥，共三人。
23.en: The sons of Ladan: Jehiel the first, Zetham and Joel-three in all.

23.zh: 示每的儿子是示罗密 、 哈薛 、 哈兰三人。这是拉但族的族长。
23.en: The sons of Shimei: Shelomoth, Haziel and Haran-three in all. These were the heads of the families of Ladan.

23.zh: 示每的儿子是雅哈 、 细拿 、 耶乌施 、 比利亚共四人。
23.en: And the sons of Shimei: Jahath, Ziza, Jeush and Beriah. These were the sons of Shimei-four in all.

23.zh: 雅哈是长子，细撒是次子。但耶乌施和比利亚的子孙不多，所以算为一族。
23.en: Jahath was the first and Ziza the second, but Jeush and Beriah did not have many sons; so they were counted as one family with one assignment.

23.zh: 哥辖的儿子是暗兰 、 以斯哈 、 希伯伦 、 乌薛共四人。
23.en: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel-four in all.

23.zh: 暗兰的儿子是亚伦 、 摩西。亚伦和他的子孙分出来，好分别至圣的物，在耶和华面前烧香 、 事奉他，奉他的名祝福，直到永远。
23.en: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses. Aaron was set apart, he and his descendants forever, to consecrate the most holy things, to offer sacrifices before the Lord , to minister before him and to pronounce blessings in his name forever.

23.zh: 至于神人摩西，他的子孙名字记在利未支派的册上。
23.en: The sons of Moses the man of God were counted as part of the tribe of Levi.

23.zh: 摩西的儿子是革舜和以利以谢。
23.en: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.

23.zh: 革舜的长子是细布业；
23.en: The descendants of Gershom: Shubael was the first.

23.zh: 以利以谢的儿子是利哈比雅。以利以谢没有别的儿子，但利哈比雅的子孙甚多。
23.en: The descendants of Eliezer: Rehabiah was the first. Eliezer had no other sons, but the sons of Rehabiah were very numerous.

23.zh: 以斯哈的长子是示罗密。
23.en: The sons of Izhar: Shelomith was the first.

23.zh: 希伯伦的长子是耶利雅，次子是亚玛利亚，三子是雅哈悉，四子是耶加面。
23.en: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third and Jekameam the fourth.

23.zh: 乌薛的长子是米迦，次子是耶西雅。
23.en: The sons of Uzziel: Micah the first and Isshiah the second.

23.zh: 米拉利的儿子是抹利 、 母示。抹利的儿子是以利亚撒 、 基士。
23.en: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.

23.zh: 以利亚撒死了，没有儿子，只有女儿，他们本族基士的儿子娶了他们为妻。
23.en: Eleazar died without having sons: he had only daughters. Their cousins, the sons of Kish, married them.

23.zh: 母示的儿子是末力 、 以得 、 耶利摩共三人。
23.en: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder and Jerimoth-three in all.

23.zh: 以上利未子孙作族长的，照著男丁的数目，从二十岁以外，都办耶和华殿的事务。
23.en: These were the descendants of Levi by their families-the heads of families as they were registered under their names and counted individually, that is, the workers twenty years old or more who served in the temple of the Lord .

23.zh: 大卫说：耶和华 ─ 以色列的神已经使他的百姓平安，他永远住在耶路撒冷。
23.en: For David had said, "Since the Lord , the God of Israel, has granted rest to his people and has come to dwell in Jerusalem forever,

23.zh: 利未人不必再抬帐幕和其中所用的一切器皿了。
23.en: the Levites no longer need to carry the tabernacle or any of the articles used in its service."

23.zh: 照著大卫临终所吩咐的，利未人从二十岁以外的都被数点。
23.en: According to the last instructions of David, the Levites were counted from those twenty years old or more.

23.zh: 他们的职任是服事亚伦的子孙，在耶和华的殿和院子，并屋中办事，洁净一切圣物，就是办神殿的事务，
23.en: The duty of the Levites was to help Aaron's descendants in the service of the temple of the Lord : to be in charge of the courtyards, the side rooms, the purification of all sacred things and the performance of other duties at the house of God.

23.zh: 并管理陈设饼，素祭的细面，或无酵薄饼，或用盘烤，或用油调和的物，又管理各样的升斗尺度；
23.en: They were in charge of the bread set out on the table, the flour for the grain offerings, the unleavened wafers, the baking and the mixing, and all measurements of quantity and size.

23.zh: 每日早晚，站立称谢赞美耶和华，
23.en: They were also to stand every morning to thank and praise the Lord . They were to do the same in the evening

23.zh: 又在安息日 、 月朔，并节期，按数照例，将燔祭常常献给耶和华；
23.en: and whenever burnt offerings were presented to the Lord on Sabbaths and at New Moon festivals and at appointed feasts. They were to serve before the Lord regularly in the proper number and in the way prescribed for them.

23.zh: 又看守会幕和圣所，并守耶和华吩咐他们弟兄亚伦子孙的，办耶和华殿的事。
23.en: And so the Levites carried out their responsibilities for the Tent of Meeting, for the Holy Place and, under their brothers the descendants of Aaron, for the service of the temple of the Lord .

24.zh: 亚伦子孙的班次记在下面：亚伦的儿子是拿答 、 亚比户 、 以利亚撒 、 以他玛。
24.en: These were the divisions of the sons of Aaron: The sons of Aaron were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

24.zh: 拿答 、 亚比户死在他们父亲之先，没有留下儿子；故此，以利亚撒 、 以他玛供祭司的职分。
24.en: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father did, and they had no sons; so Eleazar and Ithamar served as the priests.

24.zh: 以利亚撒的子孙撒督和以他玛的子孙亚希米勒，同著大卫将他们的族弟兄分成班次。
24.en: With the help of Zadok a descendant of Eleazar and Ahimelech a descendant of Ithamar, David separated them into divisions for their appointed order of ministering.

24.zh: 以利亚撒子孙中为首的比以他玛子孙中为首的更多，分班如下：以利亚撒的子孙中有十六个族长，以他玛的子孙中有八个族长；
24.en: A larger number of leaders were found among Eleazar's descendants than among Ithamar's, and they were divided accordingly: sixteen heads of families from Eleazar's descendants and eight heads of families from Ithamar's descendants.

24.zh: 都掣签分立，彼此一样。在圣所和神面前作首领的有以利亚撒的子孙，也有以他玛的子孙。
24.en: They divided them impartially by drawing lots, for there were officials of the sanctuary and officials of God among the descendants of both Eleazar and Ithamar.

24.zh: 作书记的利未人拿坦业的儿子示玛雅在王和首领，与祭司撒督 、 亚比亚他的儿子亚希米勒，并祭司利未人的族长面前记录他们的名字。在以利亚撒的子孙中取一族，在以他玛的子孙中取一族。
24.en: The scribe Shemaiah son of Nethanel, a Levite, recorded their names in the presence of the king and of the officials: Zadok the priest, Ahimelech son of Abiathar and the heads of families of the priests and of the Levites-one family being taken from Eleazar and then one from Ithamar.

24.zh: 掣签的时候，第一掣出来的是耶何雅立，第二是耶大雅，
24.en: The first lot fell to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,

24.zh: 第三是哈琳，第四是梭琳，
24.en: the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,

24.zh: 第五是玛基雅，第六是米雅民，
24.en: the fifth to Malkijah, the sixth to Mijamin,

24.zh: 第七是哈歌斯，第八是亚比雅，
24.en: the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,

24.zh: 第九是耶书亚，第十是示迦尼，
24.en: the ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,

24.zh: 第十一是以利亚实，第十二是雅金，
24.en: the eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,

24.zh: 第十三是胡巴，第十四是耶是比押，
24.en: the thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,

24.zh: 第十五是璧迦，第十六是音麦，
24.en: the fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,

24.zh: 第十七是希悉，第十八是哈辟悉，
24.en: the seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Happizzez,

24.zh: 第十九是毗他希雅，第二十是以西结，
24.en: the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezkel,

24.zh: 第二十一是雅斤，第二十二是迦末，
24.en: the twenty-first to Jakin, the twenty-second to Gamul,

24.zh: 第二十三是第来雅，第二十四是玛西亚。
24.en: the twenty-third to Delaiah and the twenty-fourth to Maaziah.

24.zh: 这就是他们的班次，要照耶和华 ─ 以色列的神藉他们祖宗亚伦所吩咐的条例进入耶和华的殿办理事务。
24.en: This was their appointed order of ministering when they entered the temple of the Lord , according to the regulations prescribed for them by their forefather Aaron, as the Lord , the God of Israel, had commanded him.

24.zh: 利未其余的子孙如下：暗兰的子孙里有书巴业；书巴业的子孙里有耶希底亚。
24.en: As for the rest of the descendants of Levi: from the sons of Amram: Shubael; from the sons of Shubael: Jehdeiah.

24.zh: 利哈比雅的子孙里有长子伊示雅。
24.en: As for Rehabiah, from his sons: Isshiah was the first.

24.zh: 以斯哈的子孙里有示罗摩；示罗摩的子孙里有雅哈。
24.en: From the Izharites: Shelomoth; from the sons of Shelomoth: Jahath.

24.zh: 希伯伦的子孙里有长子耶利雅，次子亚玛利亚，三子雅哈悉，四子耶加面。
24.en: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third and Jekameam the fourth.

24.zh: 乌薛的子孙里有米迦；米迦的子孙里有沙密。
24.en: The son of Uzziel: Micah; from the sons of Micah: Shamir.

24.zh: 米迦的兄弟是伊示雅；伊示雅的子孙里有撒迦利雅。
24.en: The brother of Micah: Isshiah; from the sons of Isshiah: Zechariah.

24.zh: 米拉利的儿子是抹利 、 母示 、 雅西雅；雅西雅的儿子有比挪；
24.en: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The son of Jaaziah: Beno.

24.zh: 米拉利的子孙里有雅西雅的儿子比挪 、 朔含 、 撒刻 、 伊比利。
24.en: The sons of Merari: from Jaaziah: Beno, Shoham, Zaccur and Ibri.

24.zh: 抹利的儿子是以利亚撒；以利亚撒没有儿子。
24.en: From Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.

24.zh: 基士的子孙里有耶拉篾。
24.en: From Kish: the son of Kish: Jerahmeel.

24.zh: 母示的儿子是末力 、 以得 、 耶利摩。按著宗族这都是利未的子孙。
24.en: And the sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder and Jerimoth. These were the Levites, according to their families.

24.zh: 他们在大卫王和撒督，并亚希米勒与祭司利未人的族长面前掣签，正如他们弟兄亚伦的子孙一般。各族的长者与兄弟没有分别。
24.en: They also cast lots, just as their brothers the descendants of Aaron did, in the presence of King David and of Zadok, Ahimelech, and the heads of families of the priests and of the Levites. The families of the oldest brother were treated the same as those of the youngest.

25.zh: 大卫和众首领分派亚萨 、 希幔，并耶杜顿的子孙弹琴 、 鼓瑟 、 敲钹 、 唱歌 ( 原文作说预言；本章同 ) 。他们供职的人数记在下面：
25.en: David, together with the commanders of the army, set apart some of the sons of Asaph, Heman and Jeduthun for the ministry of prophesying, accompanied by harps, lyres and cymbals. Here is the list of the men who performed this service:

25.zh: 亚萨的儿子撒刻 、 约瑟 、 尼探雅 、 亚萨利拉都归亚萨指教，遵王的旨意唱歌。
25.en: From the sons of Asaph: Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah and Asarelah. The sons of Asaph were under the supervision of Asaph, who prophesied under the king's supervision.

25.zh: 耶杜顿的儿子基大利 、 西利 、 耶筛亚 、 哈沙比雅 、 玛他提雅 、 示每共六人，都归他们父亲耶杜顿指教，弹琴，唱歌，称谢，颂赞耶和华。
25.en: As for Jeduthun, from his sons: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah and Mattithiah, six in all, under the supervision of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied, using the harp in thanking and praising the Lord .

25.zh: 希幔的儿子布基雅 、 玛探雅 、 乌薛 、 细布业 、 耶利摩 、 哈拿尼雅 、 哈拿尼 、 以利亚他 、 基大利提 、 罗幔提 • 以谢 、 约施比加沙 、 玛罗提 、 何提 、 玛哈秀；
25.en: As for Heman, from his sons: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shubael and Jerimoth; Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti and Romamti-Ezer; Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir and Mahazioth.

25.zh: 这都是希幔的儿子，吹角颂赞。希幔奉神之命作王的先见。神赐给希幔十四个儿子，三个女儿，
25.en: All these were sons of Heman the king's seer. They were given him through the promises of God to exalt him. God gave Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

25.zh: 都归他们父亲指教，在耶和华的殿唱歌 、 敲钹 、 弹琴 、 鼓瑟，办神殿的事务。亚萨 、 耶杜顿 、 希幔都是王所命定的。
25.en: All these men were under the supervision of their fathers for the music of the temple of the Lord , with cymbals, lyres and harps, for the ministry at the house of God. Asaph, Jeduthun and Heman were under the supervision of the king.

25.zh: 他们和他们的弟兄学习颂赞耶和华；善于歌唱的共有二百八十八人。
25.en: Along with their relatives-all of them trained and skilled in music for the Lord -they numbered 288.

25.zh: 这些人无论大小，为师的 、 为徒的，都一同掣签分了班次。
25.en: Young and old alike, teacher as well as student, cast lots for their duties.

25.zh: 掣签的时候，第一掣出来的是亚萨的儿子约瑟。第二是基大利；他和他弟兄并儿子共十二人。
25.en: The first lot, which was for Asaph, fell to Joseph, his sons and relatives, 12 the second to Gedaliah, he and his relatives and sons, 12

25.zh: 第三是撒刻；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。
25.en: the third to Zaccur, his sons and relatives, 12

25.zh: 第四是伊洗利；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。
25.en: the fourth to Izri, his sons and relatives, 12

25.zh: 第五是尼探雅；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。
25.en: the fifth to Nethaniah, his sons and relatives, 12

25.zh: 第六是布基雅；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。
25.en: the sixth to Bukkiah, his sons and relatives, 12

25.zh: 第七是耶萨利拉；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。
25.en: the seventh to Jesarelah, his sons and relatives, 12

25.zh: 第八是耶筛亚；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。
25.en: the eighth to Jeshaiah, his sons and relatives, 12

25.zh: 第九是玛探雅；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。
25.en: the ninth to Mattaniah, his sons and relatives, 12

25.zh: 第十是示每；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。
25.en: the tenth to Shimei, his sons and relatives, 12

25.zh: 第十一是亚萨烈；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。
25.en: the eleventh to Azarel, his sons and relatives, 12

25.zh: 第十二是哈沙比雅；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。
25.en: the twelfth to Hashabiah, his sons and relatives, 12

25.zh: 第十三是书巴业；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。
25.en: the thirteenth to Shubael, his sons and relatives, 12

25.zh: 第十四是玛他提雅；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。
25.en: the fourteenth to Mattithiah, his sons and relatives, 12

25.zh: 第十五是耶利摩；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。
25.en: the fifteenth to Jerimoth, his sons and relatives, 12

25.zh: 第十六是哈拿尼雅；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。
25.en: the sixteenth to Hananiah, his sons and relatives, 12

25.zh: 第十七是约施比加沙；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。
25.en: the seventeenth to Joshbekashah, his sons and relatives, 12

25.zh: 第十八是哈拿尼；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。
25.en: the eighteenth to Hanani, his sons and relatives, 12

25.zh: 第十九是玛罗提；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。
25.en: the nineteenth to Mallothi, his sons and relatives, 12

25.zh: 第二十是以利亚他；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。
25.en: the twentieth to Eliathah, his sons and relatives, 12

25.zh: 第二十一是何提；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。
25.en: the twenty-first to Hothir, his sons and relatives, 12

25.zh: 第二十二是基大利提；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。
25.en: the twenty-second to Giddalti, his sons and relatives, 12

25.zh: 第二十三是玛哈秀；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。
25.en: the twenty-third to Mahazioth, his sons and relatives, 12

25.zh: 第二十四是罗幔提 • 以谢；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。
25.en: the twenty-fourth to Romamti-Ezer, his sons and relatives, 12

26.zh: 守门的班次记在下面：可拉族亚萨的子孙中，有可利的儿子米施利米雅。
26.en: The divisions of the gatekeepers: From the Korahites: Meshelemiah son of Kore, one of the sons of Asaph.

26.zh: 米施利米雅的长子是撒迦利亚，次子是耶叠，三子是西巴第雅，四子是耶提聂，
26.en: Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,

26.zh: 五子是以拦，六子是约哈难，七子是以利约乃。
26.en: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth and Eliehoenai the seventh.

26.zh: 俄别以东的长子是示玛雅，次子是约萨拔，三子是约亚，四子是沙甲，五子是拿坦业，
26.en: Obed-Edom also had sons: Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, Sacar the fourth, Nethanel the fifth,

26.zh: 六子是亚米利，七子是以萨迦，八子是毗乌利太，因为神赐福与俄别以东。
26.en: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh and Peullethai the eighth. (For God had blessed Obed-Edom.)

26.zh: 他的儿子示玛雅有几个儿子，都是大能的壮士，掌管父亲的家。
26.en: His son Shemaiah also had sons, who were leaders in their father's family because they were very capable men.

26.zh: 示玛雅的儿子是俄得尼 、 利法益 、 俄备得 、 以利萨巴。以利萨巴的弟兄是壮士，还有以利户和西玛迦。
26.en: The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, Rephael, Obed and Elzabad; his relatives Elihu and Semakiah were also able men.

26.zh: 这都是俄别以东的子孙，他们和他们的儿子并弟兄，都是善于办事的壮士。俄别以东的子孙共六十二人。
26.en: All these were descendants of Obed-Edom; they and their sons and their relatives were capable men with the strength to do the work-descendants of Obed-Edom, 62 in all.

26.zh: 米施利米雅的儿子和弟兄都是壮士，共十八人。
26.en: Meshelemiah had sons and relatives, who were able men-18 in all.

26.zh: 米拉利子孙何萨有几个儿子：长子是申利，他原不是长子，是他父亲立他作长子。
26.en: Hosah the Merarite had sons: Shimri the first (although he was not the firstborn, his father had appointed him the first),

26.zh: 次子是希勒家，三子是底巴利雅，四子是撒迦利亚。何萨的儿子并弟兄共十三人。
26.en: Hilkiah the second, Tabaliah the third and Zechariah the fourth. The sons and relatives of Hosah were 13 in all.

26.zh: 这些人都是守门的班长，与他们的弟兄一同在耶和华殿里按班供职。
26.en: These divisions of the gatekeepers, through their chief men, had duties for ministering in the temple of the Lord , just as their relatives had.

26.zh: 他们无论大小，都按著宗族掣签分守各门。
26.en: Lots were cast for each gate, according to their families, young and old alike.

26.zh: 掣签守东门的是示利米雅；他的儿子撒迦利亚是精明的谋士，掣签守北门。
26.en: The lot for the East Gate fell to Shelemiah. Then lots were cast for his son Zechariah, a wise counselor, and the lot for the North Gate fell to him.

26.zh: 俄别以东守南门，他的儿子守库房。
26.en: The lot for the South Gate fell to Obed-Edom, and the lot for the storehouse fell to his sons.

26.zh: 书聘与何萨守西门，在靠近沙利基门 、 通著往上去的街道上，班与班相对。
26.en: The lots for the West Gate and the Shalleketh Gate on the upper road fell to Shuppim and Hosah. Guard was alongside of guard:

26.zh: 每日东门有六个利未人，北门有四个，南门有四个，库房有两个，又有两个轮班替换。
26.en: There were six Levites a day on the east, four a day on the north, four a day on the south and two at a time at the storehouse.

26.zh: 在西面街道上有四个，在游廊上有两个。
26.en: As for the court to the west, there were four at the road and two at the court itself.

26.zh: 以上是可拉子孙和米拉利子孙守门的班次。
26.en: These were the divisions of the gatekeepers who were descendants of Korah and Merari.

26.zh: 利未子孙中有亚希雅掌管神殿的府库和圣物的府库。
26.en: Their fellow Levites were in charge of the treasuries of the house of God and the treasuries for the dedicated things.

26.zh: 革顺族 、 拉但子孙里，作族长的是革顺族拉但的子孙耶希伊利。
26.en: The descendants of Ladan, who were Gershonites through Ladan and who were heads of families belonging to Ladan the Gershonite, were Jehieli,

26.zh: 耶希伊利的儿子西坦和他兄弟约珥掌管耶和华殿里的府库。
26.en: the sons of Jehieli, Zetham and his brother Joel. They were in charge of the treasuries of the temple of the Lord .

26.zh: 暗兰族 、 以斯哈族 、 希伯伦族 、 乌泄族也有职分。
26.en: From the Amramites, the Izharites, the Hebronites and the Uzzielites:

26.zh: 摩西的孙子 、 革舜的儿子细布业掌管府库。
26.en: Shubael, a descendant of Gershom son of Moses, was the officer in charge of the treasuries.

26.zh: 还有他的弟兄以利以谢。以利以谢的儿子是利哈比雅；利哈比雅的儿子是耶筛亚；耶筛亚的儿子是约兰；约兰的儿子是细基利；细基利的儿子是示罗密。
26.en: His relatives through Eliezer: Rehabiah his son, Jeshaiah his son, Joram his son, Zicri his son and Shelomith his son.

26.zh: 这示罗密和他的弟兄掌管府库的圣物，就是大卫王和众族长 、 千夫长 、 百夫长，并军长所分别为圣的物。
26.en: Shelomith and his relatives were in charge of all the treasuries for the things dedicated by King David, by the heads of families who were the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds, and by the other army commanders.

26.zh: 他们将争战时所夺的财物分别为圣，以备修造耶和华的殿。
26.en: Some of the plunder taken in battle they dedicated for the repair of the temple of the Lord .

26.zh: 先见撒母耳 、 基士的儿子扫罗 、 尼珥的儿子押尼珥 、 洗鲁雅的儿子约押所分别为圣的物都归示罗密和他的弟兄掌管。
26.en: And everything dedicated by Samuel the seer and by Saul son of Kish, Abner son of Ner and Joab son of Zeruiah, and all the other dedicated things were in the care of Shelomith and his relatives.

26.zh: 以斯哈族有基拿尼雅和他众子作官长和士师，管理以色列的外事。
26.en: From the Izharites: Kenaniah and his sons were assigned duties away from the temple, as officials and judges over Israel.

26.zh: 希伯伦族有哈沙比雅和他弟兄一千七百人，都是壮士，在约但河西 、 以色列地办理耶和华与王的事。
26.en: From the Hebronites: Hashabiah and his relatives-seventeen hundred able men-were responsible in Israel west of the Jordan for all the work of the Lord and for the king's service.

26.zh: 希伯伦族中有耶利雅作族长。大卫作王第四十年，在基列的雅谢，从这族中寻得大能的勇士。
26.en: As for the Hebronites, Jeriah was their chief according to the genealogical records of their families. In the fortieth year of David's reign a search was made in the records, and capable men among the Hebronites were found at Jazer in Gilead.

26.zh: 耶利雅的弟兄有二千七百人，都是壮士，且作族长；大卫王派他们在流便支派 、 迦得支派 、 玛拿西半支派中办理神和王的事。
26.en: Jeriah had twenty-seven hundred relatives, who were able men and heads of families, and King David put them in charge of the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh for every matter pertaining to God and for the affairs of the king.

27.zh: 以色列人的族长 、 千夫长 、 百夫长，和官长都分定班次，每班是二万四千人，周年按月轮流，替换出入服事王。
27.en: This is the list of the Israelites- heads of families, commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds, and their officers, who served the king in all that concerned the army divisions that were on duty month by month throughout the year. Each division consisted of 24,000 men.

27.zh: 正月第一班的班长是撒巴第业的儿子雅朔班；他班内有二万四千人。
27.en: In charge of the first division, for the first month, was Jashobeam son of Zabdiel. There were 24,000 men in his division.

27.zh: 他是法勒斯的子孙，统管正月班的一切军长。
27.en: He was a descendant of Perez and chief of all the army officers for the first month.

27.zh: 二月的班长是亚哈希人朵代，还有副官密基罗；他班内有二万四千人。
27.en: In charge of the division for the second month was Dodai the Ahohite; Mikloth was the leader of his division. There were 24,000 men in his division.

27.zh: 三月第三班的班长 ( 原文作军长；下同 ) 是祭司耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅；他班内有二万四千人。
27.en: The third army commander, for the third month, was Benaiah son of Jehoiada the priest. He was chief and there were 24,000 men in his division.

27.zh: 这比拿雅是那三十人中的勇士，管理那三十人；他班内又有他儿子暗米萨拔。
27.en: This was the Benaiah who was a mighty man among the Thirty and was over the Thirty. His son Ammizabad was in charge of his division.

27.zh: 四月第四班的班长是约押的兄弟亚撒黑。接续他的是他儿子西巴第雅；他班内有二万四千人。
27.en: The fourth, for the fourth month, was Asahel the brother of Joab; his son Zebadiah was his successor. There were 24,000 men in his division.

27.zh: 五月第五班的班长是伊斯拉人珊合；他班内有二万四千人。
27.en: The fifth, for the fifth month, was the commander Shamhuth the Izrahite. There were 24,000 men in his division.

27.zh: 六月第六班的班长是提哥亚人益吉的儿子以拉；他班内有二万四千人。
27.en: The sixth, for the sixth month, was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite. There were 24,000 men in his division.

27.zh: 七月第七班的班长是以法莲族比伦人希利斯；他班内有二万四千人。
27.en: The seventh, for the seventh month, was Helez the Pelonite, an Ephraimite. There were 24,000 men in his division.

27.zh: 八月第八班的班长是谢拉族户沙人西比该；他班内有二万四千人。
27.en: The eighth, for the eighth month, was Sibbecai the Hushathite, a Zerahite. There were 24,000 men in his division.

27.zh: 九月第九班的班长是便雅悯族亚拿突人亚比以谢；他班内有二万四千人。
27.en: The ninth, for the ninth month, was Abiezer the Anathothite, a Benjamite. There were 24,000 men in his division.

27.zh: 十月第十班的班长是谢拉族尼陀法人玛哈莱；他班内有二万四千人。
27.en: The tenth, for the tenth month, was Maharai the Netophathite, a Zerahite. There were 24,000 men in his division.

27.zh: 十一月第十一班的班长是以法莲族比拉顿人比拿雅；他班内有二万四千人。
27.en: The eleventh, for the eleventh month, was Benaiah the Pirathonite, an Ephraimite. There were 24,000 men in his division.

27.zh: 十二月第十二班的班长是俄陀聂族尼陀法人黑玳；他班内有二万四千人。
27.en: The twelfth, for the twelfth month, was Heldai the Netophathite, from the family of Othniel. There were 24,000 men in his division.

27.zh: 管理以色列众支派的记在下面：管流便人的是细基利的儿子以利以谢；管西缅人的是玛迦的儿子示法提雅；
27.en: The officers over the tribes of Israel: over the Reubenites: Eliezer son of Zicri; over the Simeonites: Shephatiah son of Maacah;

27.zh: 管利未人的是基母利的儿子哈沙比雅；管亚伦子孙的是撒督；
27.en: over Levi: Hashabiah son of Kemuel; over Aaron: Zadok;

27.zh: 管犹大人的是大卫的一个哥哥以利户，管以萨迦人的是米迦勒的儿子暗利；
27.en: over Judah: Elihu, a brother of David; over Issachar: Omri son of Michael;

27.zh: 管西布伦人的是俄巴第雅的儿子伊施玛雅；管拿弗他利人的是亚斯列的儿子耶利摩；
27.en: over Zebulun: Ishmaiah son of Obadiah; over Naphtali: Jerimoth son of Azriel;

27.zh: 管以法莲人的是阿撒细雅的儿子何细亚；管玛拿西半支派的是毗大雅的儿子约珥；
27.en: over the Ephraimites: Hoshea son of Azaziah; over half the tribe of Manasseh: Joel son of Pedaiah;

27.zh: 管基列地玛拿西那半支派的是撒迦利亚的儿子易多；管便雅悯人的是押尼珥的儿子雅西业；
27.en: over the half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead: Iddo son of Zechariah; over Benjamin: Jaasiel son of Abner;

27.zh: 管但人的是耶罗罕的儿子亚萨列。以上是以色列众支派的首领。
27.en: over Dan: Azarel son of Jeroham. These were the officers over the tribes of Israel.

27.zh: 以色列人二十岁以内的，大卫没有记其数目；因耶和华曾应许说，必加增以色列人如天上的星那样多。
27.en: David did not take the number of the men twenty years old or less, because the Lord had promised to make Israel as numerous as the stars in the sky.

27.zh: 洗鲁雅的儿子约押动手数点，当时耶和华的烈怒临到以色列人；因此，没有点完，数目也没有写在大卫王记上。
27.en: Joab son of Zeruiah began to count the men but did not finish. Wrath came on Israel on account of this numbering, and the number was not entered in the book of the annals of King David.

27.zh: 掌管王府库的是亚叠的儿子押斯马威。掌管田野城邑村庄保障之仓库的是乌西雅的儿子约拿单。
27.en: Azmaveth son of Adiel was in charge of the royal storehouses. Jonathan son of Uzziah was in charge of the storehouses in the outlying districts, in the towns, the villages and the watchtowers.

27.zh: 掌管耕田种地的是基绿的儿子以斯利。
27.en: Ezri son of Kelub was in charge of the field workers who farmed the land.

27.zh: 掌管葡萄园的是拉玛人示每。掌管葡萄园酒窖的是实弗米人撒巴底。
27.en: Shimei the Ramathite was in charge of the vineyards. Zabdi the Shiphmite was in charge of the produce of the vineyards for the wine vats.

27.zh: 掌管高原橄榄树和桑树的是基第利人巴勒哈南。掌管油库的是约阿施。
27.en: Baal- Hanan the Gederite was in charge of the olive and sycamore-fig trees in the western foothills. Joash was in charge of the supplies of olive oil.

27.zh: 掌管沙仑牧放牛群的是沙仑人施提赉。掌管山谷牧养牛群的是亚第赉的儿子沙法。
27.en: Shitrai the Sharonite was in charge of the herds grazing in Sharon. Shaphat son of Adlai was in charge of the herds in the valleys.

27.zh: 掌管驼群的是以实玛利人阿比勒。掌管驴群的是米仑人耶希底亚。掌管羊群的是夏甲人雅悉。
27.en: Obil the Ishmaelite was in charge of the camels. Jehdeiah the Meronothite was in charge of the donkeys.

27.zh: 这都是给大卫王掌管产业的。
27.en: Jaziz the Hagrite was in charge of the flocks. All these were the officials in charge of King David's property.

27.zh: 大卫的叔叔约拿单作谋士；这人有智慧，又作书记。哈摩尼的儿子耶歇作王众子的师傅。
27.en: Jonathan, David's uncle, was a counselor, a man of insight and a scribe. Jehiel son of Hacmoni took care of the king's sons.

27.zh: 亚希多弗也作王的谋士。亚基人户筛作王的陪伴。
27.en: Ahithophel was the king's counselor. Hushai the Arkite was the king's friend.

27.zh: 亚希多弗之后，有比拿雅的儿子耶何耶大和亚比亚他接续他作谋士。约押作王的元帅。
27.en: Ahithophel was succeeded by Jehoiada son of Benaiah and by Abiathar. Joab was the commander of the royal army.

28.zh: 大卫招聚以色列各支派的首领和轮班服事王的军长，与千夫长 、 百夫长，掌管王和王子产业牲畜的，并太监，以及大能的勇士，都到耶路撒冷来。
28.en: David summoned all the officials of Israel to assemble at Jerusalem: the officers over the tribes, the commanders of the divisions in the service of the king, the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds, and the officials in charge of all the property and livestock belonging to the king and his sons, together with the palace officials, the mighty men and all the brave warriors.

28.zh: 大卫王就站起来，说：我的弟兄，我的百姓啊，你们当听我言，我心里本想建造殿宇，安放耶和华的约柜，作为我神的脚凳；我已经预备建造的材料。
28.en: King David rose to his feet and said: "Listen to me, my brothers and my people. I had it in my heart to build a house as a place of rest for the ark of the covenant of the Lord , for the footstool of our God, and I made plans to build it.

28.zh: 只是神对我说：你不可为我的名建造殿宇；因你是战士，流了人的血。
28.en: But God said to me, 'You are not to build a house for my Name, because you are a warrior and have shed blood.'

28.zh: 然而，耶和华 ─ 以色列的神在我父的全家拣选我作以色列的王，直到永远。因他拣选犹大为首领；在犹大支派中拣选我父家，在我父的众子里喜悦我，立我作以色列众人的王。
28.en: "Yet the Lord , the God of Israel, chose me from my whole family to be king over Israel forever. He chose Judah as leader, and from the house of Judah he chose my family, and from my father's sons he was pleased to make me king over all Israel.

28.zh: 耶和华赐我许多儿子，在我儿子中拣选所罗门坐耶和华的国位，治理以色列人。
28.en: Of all my sons-and the Lord has given me many-he has chosen my son Solomon to sit on the throne of the kingdom of the Lord over Israel.

28.zh: 耶和华对我说：你儿子所罗门必建造我的殿和院宇；因为我拣选他作我的子，我也必作他的父。
28.en: He said to me: 'Solomon your son is the one who will build my house and my courts, for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.

28.zh: 他若恒久遵行我的诫命典章如今日一样，我就必坚定他的国位，直到永远。
28.en: I will establish his kingdom forever if he is unswerving in carrying out my commands and laws, as is being done at this time.'

28.zh: 现今在耶和华的会中，以色列众人眼前所说的，我们的神也听见了。你们应当寻求耶和华 ─ 你们神的一切诫命，谨守遵行，如此你们可以承受这美地，遗留给你们的子孙，永远为业。
28.en: "So now I charge you in the sight of all Israel and of the assembly of the Lord , and in the hearing of our God: Be careful to follow all the commands of the Lord your God, that you may possess this good land and pass it on as an inheritance to your descendants forever.

28.zh: 我儿所罗门哪，你当认识耶和华 ─ 你父的神，诚心乐意地事奉他；因为他鉴察众人的心，知道一切心思意念。你若寻求他，他必使你寻见；你若离弃他，他必永远丢弃你。
28.en: "And you, my son Solomon, acknowledge the God of your father, and serve him with wholehearted devotion and with a willing mind, for the Lord searches every heart and understands every motive behind the thoughts. If you seek him, he will be found by you; but if you forsake him, he will reject you forever.

28.zh: 你当谨慎，因耶和华拣选你建造殿宇作为圣所。你当刚强去行。
28.en: Consider now, for the Lord has chosen you to build a temple as a sanctuary. Be strong and do the work."

28.zh: 大卫将殿的游廊 、 旁屋 、 府库 、 楼房 、 内殿，和施恩所的样式指示他儿子所罗门，
28.en: Then David gave his son Solomon the plans for the portico of the temple, its buildings, its storerooms, its upper parts, its inner rooms and the place of atonement.

28.zh: 又将被灵感动所得的样式，就是耶和华神殿的院子 、 周围的房屋 、 殿的府库，和圣物府库的一切样式都指示他；
28.en: He gave him the plans of all that the Spirit had put in his mind for the courts of the temple of the Lord and all the surrounding rooms, for the treasuries of the temple of God and for the treasuries for the dedicated things.

28.zh: 又指示他祭司和利未人的班次与耶和华殿里各样的工作，并耶和华殿里一切器皿的样式，
28.en: He gave him instructions for the divisions of the priests and Levites, and for all the work of serving in the temple of the Lord , as well as for all the articles to be used in its service.

28.zh: 以及各样应用金器的分两和各样应用银器的分两，
28.en: He designated the weight of gold for all the gold articles to be used in various kinds of service, and the weight of silver for all the silver articles to be used in various kinds of service:

28.zh: 金灯台和金灯的分两，银灯台和银灯的分两，轻重各都合宜；
28.en: the weight of gold for the gold lampstands and their lamps, with the weight for each lampstand and its lamps; and the weight of silver for each silver lampstand and its lamps, according to the use of each lampstand;

28.zh: 陈设饼金桌子的分两，银桌子的分两，
28.en: the weight of gold for each table for consecrated bread; the weight of silver for the silver tables;

28.zh: 精金的肉叉子 、 盘子，和爵的分两，各金碗与各银碗的分两，
28.en: the weight of pure gold for the forks, sprinkling bowls and pitchers; the weight of gold for each gold dish; the weight of silver for each silver dish;

28.zh: 精金香坛的分两，并用金子做基路伯 ( 原文作用金子做车式的基路伯 ) ；基路伯张开翅膀，遮掩耶和华的约柜。
28.en: and the weight of the refined gold for the altar of incense. He also gave him the plan for the chariot, that is, the cherubim of gold that spread their wings and shelter the ark of the covenant of the Lord .

28.zh: 大卫说：这一切工作的样式都是耶和华用手划出来使我明白的。
28.en: "All this," David said, "I have in writing from the hand of the Lord upon me, and he gave me understanding in all the details of the plan."

28.zh: 大卫又对他儿子所罗门说：你当刚强壮胆去行！不要惧怕，也不要惊惶。因为耶和华神就是我的神，与你同在；他必不撇下你，也不丢弃你，直到耶和华殿的工作都完毕了。
28.en: David also said to Solomon his son, "Be strong and courageous, and do the work. Do not be afraid or discouraged, for the Lord God, my God, is with you. He will not fail you or forsake you until all the work for the service of the temple of the Lord is finished.

28.zh: 有祭司和利未人的各班，为要办理神殿各样的事，又有灵巧的人在各样的工作上乐意帮助你；并有众首领和众民一心听从你的命令。
28.en: The divisions of the priests and Levites are ready for all the work on the temple of God, and every willing man skilled in any craft will help you in all the work. The officials and all the people will obey your every command."

29.zh: 大卫王对会众说：我儿子所罗门是神特选的，还年幼娇嫩；这工程甚大，因这殿不是为人，乃是为耶和华神建造的。
29.en: Then King David said to the whole assembly: "My son Solomon, the one whom God has chosen, is young and inexperienced. The task is great, because this palatial structure is not for man but for the Lord God.

29.zh: 我为我神的殿已经尽力，预备金子做金器，银子做银器，铜做铜器，铁做铁器，木做木器，还有红玛瑙可镶嵌的宝石，彩石和一切的宝石，并许多汉白玉。
29.en: With all my resources I have provided for the temple of my God-gold for the gold work, silver for the silver, bronze for the bronze, iron for the iron and wood for the wood, as well as onyx for the settings, turquoise, stones of various colors, and all kinds of fine stone and marble-all of these in large quantities.

29.zh: 且因我心中爱慕我神的殿，就在预备建造圣殿的材料之外，又将我自己积蓄的金银献上，建造我神的殿，
29.en: Besides, in my devotion to the temple of my God I now give my personal treasures of gold and silver for the temple of my God, over and above everything I have provided for this holy temple:

29.zh: 就是俄斐金三千他连得 、 精炼的银子七千他连得，以贴殿墙。
29.en: three thousand talents of gold (gold of Ophir) and seven thousand talents of refined silver, for the overlaying of the walls of the buildings,

29.zh: 金子做金器，银子做银器，并藉匠人的手制造一切。今日有谁乐意将自己献给耶和华呢？
29.en: for the gold work and the silver work, and for all the work to be done by the craftsmen. Now, who is willing to consecrate himself today to the Lord ?"

29.zh: 于是，众族长和以色列各支派的首领 、 千夫长 、 百夫长，并监管王工的官长，都乐意献上。
29.en: Then the leaders of families, the officers of the tribes of Israel, the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds, and the officials in charge of the king's work gave willingly.

29.zh: 他们为神殿的使用献上金子五千他连得零一万达利克，银子一万他连得，铜一万八千他连得，铁十万他连得。
29.en: They gave toward the work on the temple of God five thousand talents and ten thousand darics of gold, ten thousand talents of silver, eighteen thousand talents of bronze and a hundred thousand talents of iron.

29.zh: 凡有宝石的都交给革顺人耶歇，送入耶和华殿的府库。
29.en: Any who had precious stones gave them to the treasury of the temple of the Lord in the custody of Jehiel the Gershonite.

29.zh: 因这些人诚心乐意献给耶和华，百姓就欢喜，大卫王也大大欢喜。
29.en: The people rejoiced at the willing response of their leaders, for they had given freely and wholeheartedly to the Lord . David the king also rejoiced greatly.

29.zh: 所以，大卫在会众面前称颂耶和华说：耶和华 ─ 我们的父，以色列的神是应当称颂，直到永永远远的！
29.en: David praised the Lord in the presence of the whole assembly, saying, "Praise be to you, O Lord , God of our father Israel, from everlasting to everlasting.

29.zh: 耶和华啊，尊大 、 能力 、 荣耀 、 强胜 、 威严都是你的；凡天上地下的都是你的；国度也是你的，并且你为至高，为万有之首。
29.en: Yours, O Lord , is the greatness and the power and the glory and the majesty and the splendor, for everything in heaven and earth is yours. Yours, O Lord , is the kingdom; you are exalted as head over all.

29.zh: 丰富尊荣都从你而来，你也治理万物。在你手里有大能大力，使人尊大强盛都出于你。
29.en: Wealth and honor come from you; you are the ruler of all things. In your hands are strength and power to exalt and give strength to all.

29.zh: 我们的神啊，现在我们称谢你，赞美你荣耀之名！
29.en: Now, our God, we give you thanks, and praise your glorious name.

29.zh: 我算甚么，我的民算甚么，竟能如此乐意奉献？因为万物都从你而来，我们把从你而得的献给你。
29.en: "But who am I, and who are my people, that we should be able to give as generously as this? Everything comes from you, and we have given you only what comes from your hand.

29.zh: 我们在你面前是客旅，是寄居的，与我们列祖一样。我们在世的日子如影儿，不能长存 ( 或作没有长存的指望 ) 。
29.en: We are aliens and strangers in your sight, as were all our forefathers. Our days on earth are like a shadow, without hope.

29.zh: 耶和华 ─ 我们的神啊，我们预备这许多材料，要为你的圣名建造殿宇，都是从你而来，都是属你的。
29.en: O Lord our God, as for all this abundance that we have provided for building you a temple for your Holy Name, it comes from your hand, and all of it belongs to you.

29.zh: 我的神啊，我知道你察验人心，喜悦正直；我以正直的心乐意献上这一切物。现在我喜欢见你的民在这里都乐意奉献与你。
29.en: I know, my God, that you test the heart and are pleased with integrity. All these things have I given willingly and with honest intent. And now I have seen with joy how willingly your people who are here have given to you.

29.zh: 耶和华 ─ 我们列祖亚伯拉罕 、 以撒 、 以色列的神啊，求你使你的民常存这样的心思意念，坚定他们的心归向你，
29.en: O Lord , God of our fathers Abraham, Isaac and Israel, keep this desire in the hearts of your people forever, and keep their hearts loyal to you.

29.zh: 又求你赐我儿子所罗门诚实的心，遵守你的命令 、 法度 、 律例，成就这一切的事，用我所预备的建造殿宇。
29.en: And give my son Solomon the wholehearted devotion to keep your commands, requirements and decrees and to do everything to build the palatial structure for which I have provided."

29.zh: 大卫对全会众说：你们应当称颂耶和华 ─ 你们的神。于是会众称颂耶和华 ─ 他们列祖的神，低头拜耶和华与王。
29.en: Then David said to the whole assembly, "Praise the Lord your God." So they all praised the Lord , the God of their fathers; they bowed low and fell prostrate before the Lord and the king.

29.zh: 次日，他们向耶和华献平安祭和燔祭，就是献公牛一千只，公绵羊一千只，羊羔一千只，并同献的奠祭；又为以色列众人献许多的祭。那日，他们在耶和华面前吃喝，大大欢乐。
29.en: The next day they made sacrifices to the Lord and presented burnt offerings to him: a thousand bulls, a thousand rams and a thousand male lambs, together with their drink offerings, and other sacrifices in abundance for all Israel.

29.zh: 他们奉耶和华的命再膏大卫的儿子所罗门作王，又膏撒督作祭司。
29.en: They ate and drank with great joy in the presence of the Lord that day. Then they acknowledged Solomon son of David as king a second time, anointing him before the Lord to be ruler and Zadok to be priest.

29.zh: 于是所罗门坐在耶和华所赐的位上，接续他父亲大卫作王，万事亨通；以色列众人也都听从他。
29.en: So Solomon sat on the throne of the Lord as king in place of his father David. He prospered and all Israel obeyed him.

29.zh: 众首领和勇士，并大卫王的众子，都顺服所罗门王。
29.en: All the officers and mighty men, as well as all of King David's sons, pledged their submission to King Solomon.

29.zh: 耶和华使所罗门在以色列众人眼前甚为尊大，极其威严，胜过在他以前的以色列王。
29.en: The Lord highly exalted Solomon in the sight of all Israel and bestowed on him royal splendor such as no king over Israel ever had before.

29.zh: 耶西的儿子大卫作以色列众人的王，
29.en: David son of Jesse was king over all Israel.

29.zh: 作王共四十年：在希伯仑作王七年，在耶路撒冷作王三十三年。
29.en: He ruled over Israel forty years-seven in Hebron and thirty-three in Jerusalem.

29.zh: 他年纪老迈，日子满足，享受丰富 、 尊荣，就死了。他儿子所罗门接续他作王。
29.en: He died at a good old age, having enjoyed long life, wealth and honor. His son Solomon succeeded him as king.

29.zh: 大卫王始终的事都写在先见撒母耳的书上和先知拿单并先见迦得的书上。
29.en: As for the events of King David's reign, from beginning to end, they are written in the records of Samuel the seer, the records of Nathan the prophet and the records of Gad the seer,

29.zh: 他的国事和他的勇力，以及他和以色列并列国所经过的事都写在这书上。
